entities.title: zazzle-llm
entities.summary: `zazzle agent llm` and `zazzle agent prompt`: runs open-weight models (Qwen, Gemma 4, gpt-oss) on the developer's own machine with llama.cpp. `llm` lists a pinned catalogue of ten GGUF models, downloads one and makes it and an effort the default, or removes one; `prompt` asks a model and streams its answer, downloading the model first when it is missing.
entities.purpose: The crate of the zazzle-llm binary: Cargo.toml (each dependency commented with its one reason, and the `metal` feature for GPU inference on Apple Silicon), the user README, and the binary and its unit tests in src/. It is one member of the Cargo workspace in macos/rust.
boundaries: It is a JIT tool: not in the release tarball, the bottle or the formula. The zazzle invoker (macos/c/zazzle) execs `zazzled llm llm|prompt ..`, and zazzled (macos/rust/zazzled/src/tools.rs) uses a zazzle-llm beside itself or downloads it from icelander.net, checks it against the manifest compiled into zazzled and execs it.
It downloads model files itself, from huggingface.co at the commit and SHA-256 its catalogue pins, into its own directory (~/.zazzle/v1/llm by default); zazzled never sees a model.

macos/release/tools.sh builds it (universal on macOS, with Metal for Apple Silicon) and writes the tool manifest; the release workflow signs and uploads it. Workspace release builds leave it out (`--exclude zazzle-llm`).
